# Cobalt Holdings: earnings call, third quarter 2025

Date: 2025-10-29

Irene Ruiz (Chief Executive): Revenue for the quarter was USD 215.6 million. Order books are in line with our plan.

Olivia Brennan (Chief Financial Officer): We kept a close eye on costs across our plants. Returns rose sharply this quarter because of a faulty batch of labelling line parts. We are replacing every affected unit at our own cost.

Analyst: Will you keep investing in new products?

Irene Ruiz: Research is the engine of this company and we fund it accordingly.

# Cobalt Holdings: earnings call, fourth quarter 2025

Date: 2026-02-25

Irene Ruiz (Chief Executive): Revenue for the quarter was USD 192.6 million. Demand from cosmetics brand customers stayed healthy.

Olivia Brennan (Chief Financial Officer): Freight costs eased a little. Product quality remained excellent and returns were negligible.

Analyst: Will you keep investing in new products?

Irene Ruiz: Research is the engine of this company and we fund it accordingly.

# Cobalt Holdings: earnings call, first quarter 2026

Date: 2026-04-28

Irene Ruiz (Chief Executive): Revenue for the quarter was USD 201.1 million. Demand from dairy cooperative customers stayed healthy.

Olivia Brennan (Chief Financial Officer): We kept a close eye on costs across our plants. Product quality remained excellent and returns were negligible.

Analyst: Will you keep investing in new products?

Irene Ruiz: Research is the engine of this company and we fund it accordingly.

# Cobalt Holdings: earnings call, second quarter 2026

Date: 2026-07-29

Irene Ruiz (Chief Executive): Revenue for the quarter was USD 227.7 million. Demand from cosmetics brand customers stayed healthy.

Olivia Brennan (Chief Financial Officer): Freight costs eased a little. Returns stayed low and product quality was steady.

Analyst: Will you keep investing in new products?

Irene Ruiz: We invest for the long term and our research budget reflects that.

arguments.query:
WITH r AS (
 SELECT substr(order_date,1,4)||'Q'||((CAST(substr(order_date,6,2) AS INTEGER)+2)/3) AS quarter,
 SUM(amount) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT substr(order_date,1,7)) AS order_months,
 COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
 SUM(CASE WHEN typeof(amount) IN ('integer','real') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_orders
 FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-07-01'
 GROUP BY quarter
), c AS (
 SELECT substr(month,1,4)||'Q'||((CAST(substr(month,6,2) AS INTEGER)+2)/3) AS quarter,
 SUM(cost_of_sales) AS cost_of_sales, SUM(selling_admin) AS selling_admin,
 SUM(research_development) AS research_development, COUNT(DISTINCT month) AS cost_months,
 COUNT(*) AS total_costs,
 SUM(CASE WHEN typeof(cost_of_sales) IN ('integer','real')
 AND typeof(selling_admin) IN ('integer','real')
 AND typeof(research_development) IN ('integer','real') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_costs
 FROM monthly_costs WHERE month >= '2024-01' AND month < '2026-07'
 GROUP BY quarter
)
SELECT r.quarter, revenue, order_months, cost_of_sales, selling_admin,
 research_development, cost_months, valid_orders, total_orders, valid_costs, total_costs
FROM r LEFT JOIN c ON r.quarter=c.quarter ORDER BY r.quarter

SELECT substr(month,1,4)||'Q'||((CAST(substr(month,6,2) AS INTEGER)+2)/3) AS quarter, COUNT(*) AS rows, COUNT(DISTINCT month) AS months, SUM(units_shipped) AS shipped, SUM(units_returned) AS returned, SUM(CASE WHEN typeof(units_shipped) IN ('integer','real') AND typeof(units_returned) IN ('integer','real') AND units_shipped >= 0 AND units_returned >= 0 AND units_returned <= units_shipped THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_rows, ROUND(100.0*SUM(units_returned)/NULLIF(SUM(units_shipped),0),6) AS return_rate_pct FROM returns WHERE month >= '2024-01' AND month < '2026-07' GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY quarter
